annotations.title: Starter Protection: Back to Monitor Mode

description: Switch an app's starter protection back to monitor mode: its rules keep alerting, none of them blocks. Use it when a starter rule blocked legitimate traffic, then tune or exclude the rule. Write action; requires confirmation.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.
